displayName.en: 【New Year's Shrine Witch】 Lilith the First

profile.ja: 魔界の住人なら誰もが恐れ、３００キロは避けて通るといわれる伝説の大魔女リリス。彼女はその孫娘である。その寿命は数万年に及ぶという高位魔族で、通称“黒蛇の魔女”。祖母の名を継いで二代目リリスとなった彼女は、武者修行のため人間界に降り立った。未熟ゆえ１人ではオークの群れにも逃げ惑うレベルだが、才能は魔界随一で、秘めたる野望は誰にも負けない天然な性格。祖母の代から仕えている使い魔（＝従者）、メスの白い犬ベリリクが彼女を護衛し、普段の生活をサポートしている。その正体は神殺しで知られる古代龍（エンシェント・ドラゴン）だが、リリスはちょっと長生きで人に化けれるただの白い犬だと信じて疑っていない。新年早々からうるさくはしゃぎ回るリリスに、誰かがどこからか用意した巫女服を着せ、自称“初詣の魔女”が爆誕した。本人曰く、新年の波動を全身から迸らせているらしい。その衣装から感じる神聖さや、気が引き締まるような感覚に、さすがのリリスも少しはおしとやかになるのだろうか。
profile.en: Lilith the First is the legendary Grand Witch Lilith, feared by every resident of the Demon Realm—so much so that people steer clear for hundreds of kilometers. She is Lilith's granddaughter. As a high-ranking demon with a lifespan of tens of thousands of years, she's known as the "Black Serpent Witch." Inheriting her grandmother's name, she became the second-generation Lilith and descended to the Human Realm for warrior training. Though still inexperienced enough to flee from a pack of orcs on her own, her talent is unrivaled in the Demon Realm, and her hidden ambitions are unmatched, matched only by her carefree personality. She is accompanied by her familiar—a white female dog named Berylic—who has served the family since her grandmother's era. In truth, Berylic is an ancient dragon famed for slaying gods, but Lilith firmly believes the creature is merely a long-lived white dog capable of taking human form. Early in the new year, someone supplied her with a shrine maiden outfit, and thus the self-proclaimed "New-Year's Witch" was born. According to her, she radiates the New Year's energy from every inch of her body. The sanctity and invigorating feeling of the costume seem to temper even Lilith's wild nature, making her a little more poised.

text.ja: 新年、明けましておめでとうございます。今年は幸多き、よき年となりますことをお祈り申し上げます……主に私に
text.en: Happy New Year! I pray this year will bring you abundant happiness... especially for me.

text.ja: 新春の喜びを云々……かしこみかしこみ云々……どうです？　これがみなさんに評判の、巫女っぽい祝詞（のりと）ですよ
text.en: The joy of the new spring and all that… humbly, humbly… how does it sound? This is the popular, shrine-maid-style chant that everyone's raving about.

text.ja: 今年の私は、ひと味もふた味も違いますよ……この神聖な衣装からも、その違いがわかるでしょう？
text.en: This year, I'm a whole different flavor… you can tell just by this holy outfit, can't you?

text.ja: 日本の神官……巫女っていうのもかわいい服を着ますねぇ。やっぱり神様は万国共通で、かわいい子が好きなんでしょうか
text.en: Japanese priests… shrine maidens wear such cute clothes, huh? I guess gods everywhere love cute girls.

text.ja: この衣装、清廉で厳かな私にピッタリですけど、一箇所だけ……胸が、閉じきらないんですよねぇっ……うぅ～んっ！
text.en: This outfit fits my pure and solemn self perfectly, but there's one thing… my chest just won't stay closed… ugh!

text.ja: この格好でいると、理知的に見えるって褒められるんですよ。いや～、照れちゃいます♪
text.en: People say I look intellectual in this get-up. Oh my, I'm blushing~

text.ja: まったく、新年会の余興で、こんな服を着せるなんて……まぁ神秘的で理知的な私には、ピッタリな衣装だとは思いますけどね
text.en: Honestly, making me wear this for the New Year party's entertainment… well, it's mysterious and intellectual, so I guess it suits me.

text.ja: どうでしたか、見様見真似の神楽なんですが……え？　そ、そりゃこんな服着せられたら、少しは勉強しますよ……
text.en: How was it, that copy-cat kagura? Huh? W-well, if I'm forced to wear a costume like this, I might actually learn a thing or two…
